name: Advanced SEO Suite
description: Smart meta templates, structured data and canonical URL control for Magento 2, with Hyvä and Luma support.
shortDescription: Meta templates, JSON-LD structured data and canonical URLs for Magento 2

features.title: Meta title & description templates
features.text: Separate templates for products and categories, with variables such as {{name}}, {{price}}, {{category}} and any attribute as {{attr:color}}.

features.title: Your own meta stays untouched
features.text: Templates only fill empty fields. Meta titles and descriptions you wrote by hand are never replaced.

features.title: JSON-LD structured data
features.text: Organization, WebSite with site search, Product with price and stock, and BreadcrumbList in one clean @graph block.

features.title: Clean canonical URLs
features.text: CMS pages and the homepage get a canonical URL without tracking parameters, and only one canonical tag per page.

features.title: Configurable-parent canonical
features.text: Simple products that belong to a configurable product can point their canonical URL to the parent page.

features.title: Hyvä and Luma, no extra module
features.text: Everything is rendered on the server, so it works the same on Hyvä and Luma without a compatibility module.

images.alt: Advanced SEO Suite for Magento 2: better product page SEO with templates, structured data and canonicals
Meta templates turn product data into clean search-result titles and descriptions
JSON-LD structured data feeds rich search results with price and rating details
Duplicate URLs point to one canonical page
One module that works on both Hyvä and Luma storefronts
